question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who does not believe in God
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Atheist"** means someone who does not believe in the existence of God or gods. (नास्तिक)

 
 
• **Example:** As an **atheist,** she does not participate in religious ceremonies.
 
 

Therefore, the correct one word substitution for the given phrase is: **Atheist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Catholic** (कैथोलिक): A member of the Roman Catholic Church.

 
 
• **Example:** He was raised as a **Catholic** and attends church every Sunday.
 
 
 
• **Priest** (पुजारी): A person who performs religious ceremonies and duties, especially in the Christian church.
 
 
• **Example:** The **priest **delivered a touching sermon during the service.
 
 
 
• **Reverent** (श्रद्धालु): Feeling or showing deep and solemn respect.
 
 
• **Example:** The audience was **reverent** during the memorial service.
